'''Delsa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Around [[3640 BBY]], Delsa was on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], retraining the [[Voss Mystics]] [[Yashu-Vo]] after their lessons in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Beldiss]].<ref name="TOR" />
